page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-48 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 90.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 1.88 GB per vCPU.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high vCPU count relative to memory capacity, the c4d-highcpu-48 is designed for compute-heavy workloads where raw processing power is prioritized over large memory footprints. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for parallel processing tasks, batch processing, and compute-intensive web serving, while avoiding the higher costs associated with memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances.
